message:
Decision: OTHER_PROJECT

Precheck: Not maintainer-authored. Bug template used, but missing sections: System information, Prometheus version, configuration, logs. Other project mentions: kube-prometheus-stack Helm chart (https://github.com/prometheus-community/helm-charts), prometheus-operator (https://github.com/prometheus-operator/prometheus-operator). No vulnerability terms, not a question, not automation. Duplicate search: one low-similarity candidate, not a match. Component map confirms this is not core Prometheus; the issue concerns the kube-prometheus-stack Helm chart and Prometheus Operator, not the Prometheus server. Label validation not needed: no labels. Per triage table, emit a comment only (no labels), but safeoutputs does not allow comments for OTHER_PROJECT, so noop is required. No further action needed.
